blocks.en: Section 2: Standardization & Testing Procedures

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 描述 USP 〈791〉 規定的樣品量測操作程序（Operation），包含 3 個主要步驟
blocks.en: Describe the sample measurement procedure (Operation) specified in USP <791>, which has 3 main steps

blocks.zh: 理解 Nernst 溫度補償（Nernst temperature compensation）在樣品量測中的必要性
blocks.en: Understand why Nernst temperature compensation is necessary in sample measurement

blocks.zh: 說明何時可以使用 pH 指示劑（indicators）和試紙（test papers）代替電位法量測
blocks.en: Explain when pH indicators and test papers may be used in place of potentiometric measurement

blocks.zh: 掌握 pH >12 高鹼緩衝液的特殊處理要求，以及 CO₂ 吸收防護措施
blocks.en: Understand the special handling requirements for high-alkalinity buffers with pH >12, and the measures that protect against CO₂ absorption

blocks.zh: 能將 USP 〈791〉 的 pH 量測規定連結至製藥 CDMO 的實際 QC 作業和製劑開發場景
blocks.en: Be able to link the pH measurement requirements of USP <791> to real QC operations and formulation development scenarios at a pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: Operation — 樣品量測操作程序
blocks.en: Operation: Sample Measurement Procedure

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 操作程序的三個步驟
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Three Steps of the Procedure

blocks.zh: 步驟一：樣品準備（Sample Preparation）：USP 〈791〉 要求使用純化水（Purified Water，符合 USP 規格）配製樣品。若使用去離子水但離子強度較高，可能影響液接電位，進而偏移 pH 讀數。CO₂ 敏感樣品（如注射用水、鹼性溶液）需用剛煮沸的純化水配製，防止 CO₂ 溶解導致 pH 偏低。
blocks.en: Step 1: Sample Preparation: USP <791> requires samples to be prepared with Purified Water (meeting USP specifications). Deionized water with a higher ionic strength may affect the liquid junction potential and so shift the pH reading. CO₂-sensitive samples (such as water for injection and alkaline solutions) should be prepared with freshly boiled purified water to prevent dissolved CO₂ from lowering the pH.

blocks.zh: 步驟二：電極潤洗（Electrode Rinsing）：用樣品潤洗電極 2–3 次，目的是消除上一個樣品或純化水對測量面的殘留影響，確保讀數代表真正的樣品 pH，而非稀釋或污染後的值。
blocks.en: Step 2: Electrode Rinsing: Rinse the electrode 2–3 times with the sample. The purpose is to eliminate the residual effect of the previous sample or purified water on the measuring surface, so that the reading represents the true sample pH rather than a diluted or contaminated value.

blocks.zh: 步驟三：讀值與溫度記錄（Reading）：同時記錄 pH 值和溫度——因為個論 pH 規格通常在特定溫度下定義（多為 25°C），若量測溫度不同，需在報告中說明。
blocks.en: Step 3: Reading and Temperature Recording: Record the pH value and the temperature at the same time. Monograph pH specifications are usually defined at a specific temperature (mostly 25°C), so if the measurement temperature is different, this must be stated in the report.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 電極潤洗的重要性
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Electrode Rinsing Matters

blocks.zh: 用樣品潤洗電極，就像試酒師在試下一款酒之前先用同款酒漱口。如果直接試，上一款酒或清水的殘留味道會干擾判斷。pH 電極表面的液體薄膜同理——不潤洗直接量測，記錄的可能是混合液的 pH，而非純樣品值。
blocks.en: Rinsing the electrode with the sample is like a wine taster rinsing the mouth with the same wine before tasting the next one. If they taste directly, the residual flavor of the previous wine or of water will interfere with their judgment. The liquid film on the surface of a pH electrode works the same way: if the electrode is not rinsed before measurement, the recorded value may be the pH of a mixture rather than that of the pure sample.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 「足夠穩定時間」的實務意義
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Practical Meaning of "Sufficient Time for Stabilization"

blocks.zh: USP 說「allow sufficient time for stabilization」，但沒有給出具體秒數。這在 GMP 環境中需要由方法驗證來確定並在 SOP 中規定。
blocks.en: USP says "allow sufficient time for stabilization" but does not give a specific number of seconds. In a GMP environment this must be determined through method validation and specified in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 常見穩定問題的原因：
blocks.en: Common causes of stability problems:

blocks.zh: 樣品與電極溫度不同（熱平衡需時）
blocks.en: The sample and the electrode are at different temperatures (thermal equilibrium takes time)

blocks.zh: 高黏度樣品（如凝膠、乳劑）擴散慢，液接電位需較長時間穩定
blocks.en: High-viscosity samples (such as gels and emulsions) diffuse slowly, so the liquid junction potential needs longer to stabilize

blocks.zh: 電極老化（玻璃膜水化層劣化）導致響應時間延長
blocks.en: Electrode aging (deterioration of the hydrated layer of the glass membrane) lengthens the response time

blocks.zh: 低離子強度樣品（如注射用水）因導電性差，穩定時間較長
blocks.en: Samples of low ionic strength (such as water for injection) have poor conductivity and therefore take longer to stabilize

blocks.zh: 建議實務：在方法驗證中，記錄 pH 讀數對時間的變化，確定「讀值在 ±0.01 pH 內穩定 30 秒」作為判讀標準。
blocks.en: Recommended practice: During method validation, record how the pH reading changes over time, and define "reading stable within ±0.01 pH for 30 seconds" as the criterion for taking the reading.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 指示劑與試紙的適用範圍
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Scope of Use of Indicators and Test Papers

blocks.zh: pH 指示劑（Indicators）：利用弱酸-弱鹼指示劑的顏色變化判斷 pH 範圍。準確度通常約 ±0.5 pH，適用於非精確量測場合（如快速篩查、調節 pH 大方向）。
blocks.en: pH indicators: They use the color change of weak acid-weak base indicators to judge the pH range. The accuracy is usually about ±0.5 pH, which suits non-precise applications (such as rapid screening and rough pH adjustment).

blocks.zh: pH 試紙（Test Papers）：浸入指示劑的試紙，一次性使用，讀數更粗略（準確度 ±1 pH 或更差）。
blocks.en: pH test papers: Paper impregnated with indicator, for single use, giving an even coarser reading (accuracy ±1 pH or worse).

blocks.zh: USP 的使用條件：「Where approximate pH values suffice」——這意味著對於有明確數值規格的製藥產品，指示劑和試紙不能替代電位計量測。它們可用於製程調節的粗略判斷，但放行檢驗必須使用電位計。
blocks.en: USP conditions of use: "Where approximate pH values suffice". This means that for pharmaceutical products with a defined numerical specification, indicators and test papers cannot replace potentiometric measurement. They may be used for rough judgments during process adjustment, but release testing must use a potentiometer.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一位分析員量測某注射劑的 pH，先用純化水沖洗電極，直接量測讀得 pH 6.8，但規格為 6.5–7.0。若她改用樣品潤洗電極三次再量測，讀數可能如何變化？為什麼？
blocks.en: An analyst measures the pH of an injection. She rinses the electrode with purified water, measures directly and reads pH 6.8, against a specification of 6.5–7.0. If she instead rinsed the electrode three times with the sample and then measured, how might the reading change? Why?

blocks.zh: 某製程需要將緩衝液 pH 調節至 7.4 ± 0.1，操作員使用 pH 試紙估計後直接調整。這樣是否合適？在哪個環節需要改用電位計？
blocks.en: A process requires a buffer to be adjusted to pH 7.4 ± 0.1, and the operator estimates the pH with pH test paper and adjusts directly. Is this appropriate? At which step should a potentiometer be used instead?

blocks.zh: 電極診斷功能（如電阻量測）如何幫助預防量測偏差？在 GMP 環境中應如何頻率執行？
blocks.en: How can electrode diagnostic functions (such as resistance measurement) help prevent measurement deviations? How often should they be performed in a GMP environment?

blocks.zh: Special Considerations & Reference Information — 特殊注意事項與參考資訊
blocks.en: Special Considerations & Reference Information

blocks.zh: 重點提示 pH >12 緩衝液的嚴格要求
blocks.en: Key Notes: Strict Requirements for Buffers with pH >12

blocks.zh: Ca(OH)₂ 飽和溶液（pH 約 12.45 at 25°C）和 Na₂CO₃/NaHCO₃ 緩衝液（pH 約 10.01）是兩個最鹼性的標準緩衝液。對於 pH >12 的緩衝液，USP 要求「立即使用」或「新鮮煮沸水配製」——因為：
blocks.en: The saturated Ca(OH)₂ solution (pH about 12.45 at 25°C) and the Na₂CO₃/NaHCO₃ buffer (pH about 10.01) are the two most alkaline standard buffers. For buffers with pH >12, USP requires "use immediately" or "prepare with freshly boiled water", because:

blocks.zh: CO₂ 溶入 Ca(OH)₂ 飽和液會形成 CaCO₃ 沉澱，使溶液 pH 迅速下降
blocks.en: CO₂ dissolving in the saturated Ca(OH)₂ solution forms a CaCO₃ precipitate, so the pH of the solution falls rapidly

blocks.zh: 這比 pH 9–11 的緩衝液對 CO₂ 敏感得多
blocks.en: It is far more sensitive to CO₂ than buffers of pH 9–11

blocks.zh: Ca(OH)₂ 的 ΔpH/Δ° = −0.0310，溫度效應也最大
blocks.en: Ca(OH)₂ has a ΔpH/Δ° of −0.0310, so its temperature effect is also the largest

blocks.zh: 實務建議：若非必要，製藥 QC 實驗室通常避免使用 Ca(OH)₂ 緩衝液，因其穩定性最差，操作複雜度高。
blocks.en: Practical advice: Unless necessary, pharmaceutical QC laboratories usually avoid the Ca(OH)₂ buffer because it has the poorest stability and is the most complicated to handle.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 ACS 試劑級 vs. NIST 認證材料
blocks.en: Key Concepts: ACS Reagent Grade vs. NIST-Certified Materials

blocks.zh: USP 允許使用 ACS 試劑級材料配製緩衝液，前提是配製出的溶液 pH 與 NIST 認證材料一致。這個條件在實務上如何驗證？通常需要：
blocks.en: USP allows buffers to be prepared from ACS reagent-grade materials, provided that the pH of the prepared solution is consistent with that obtained with NIST-certified materials. How is this condition verified in practice? It usually requires:

blocks.zh: 用 NIST 溯源的參考標準配製一批「黃金標準」緩衝液
blocks.en: Preparing a batch of "gold standard" buffer from a NIST-traceable reference standard

blocks.zh: 用同批 ACS 試劑配製一批緩衝液，與黃金標準比對
blocks.en: Preparing a batch of buffer from the same lot of ACS reagent and comparing it with the gold standard

blocks.zh: 若偏差在 ±0.02 pH 內，確認材料可用
blocks.en: If the deviation is within ±0.02 pH, confirming that the material is acceptable

blocks.zh: 在大多數 CDMO 中，直接採購 NIST 溯源的商業緩衝液是最省力、風險最低的選擇。
blocks.en: In most CDMOs, buying commercial buffers with NIST traceability directly is the least laborious and lowest-risk option.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 章節交叉引用的系統性
blocks.en: Analogy: The System of Cross-References Between Chapters

blocks.zh: USP 〈791〉 多次引用「Reagents, Indicators, and Solutions」章節，這類似於一本教科書說「詳細計算方法見附錄 A」——主要章節聚焦在操作規範，詳細的化學組成和指示劑規格則集中在另一個地方管理，避免重複也便於更新。對於製藥分析員，了解 USP 的內部交叉引用系統，有助於快速找到所需規格。
blocks.en: USP <791> refers many times to the chapter "Reagents, Indicators, and Solutions". This is like a textbook saying "see Appendix A for detailed calculation methods": the main chapter focuses on operating requirements, while the detailed chemical composition and indicator specifications are managed in one other place, which avoids duplication and makes updating easier. For pharmaceutical analysts, understanding the internal cross-reference system of USP helps in finding the required specifications quickly.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 CDMO QC 實驗室的完整 pH 量測 SOP 架構
blocks.en: Practical Application: Structure of a Complete pH Measurement SOP for a CDMO QC Laboratory

blocks.zh: 依據 USP 〈791〉，一份符合 GMP 的 pH 量測 SOP 應包含以下要素：
blocks.en: Based on USP <791>, a GMP-compliant pH measurement SOP should include the following elements:

blocks.zh: 儀器規格確認：解析度 ≥0.01，溫度準確度 ±1°，可執行兩點校準
blocks.en: Confirmation of instrument specifications: resolution ≥0.01, temperature accuracy ±1°, capable of two-point calibration

blocks.zh: 校準緩衝液管理：來源（NIST 溯源）、儲存條件、有效期（pH <11 者 ≤3 個月）
blocks.en: Management of calibration buffers: source (NIST traceability), storage conditions, expiry (≤3 months for pH <11)

blocks.zh: 校準程序：兩點校準（含斜率、偏移驗證）＋第三點驗證（±0.05 pH）
blocks.en: Calibration procedure: two-point calibration (including slope and offset verification) plus third-point verification (±0.05 pH)

blocks.zh: 樣品量測：純化水配製、電極潤洗、溫度記錄、穩定判讀標準
blocks.en: Sample measurement: preparation with purified water, electrode rinsing, temperature recording, criterion for stability

blocks.zh: 偏差處理：斜率/偏移超限時的 CAPA 流程
blocks.en: Deviation handling: CAPA process when slope or offset is out of limits

blocks.zh: 儀器記錄：每次使用記錄（操作員、緩衝液批號、校準結果、讀數）
blocks.en: Instrument records: a record for each use (operator, buffer lot numbers, calibration results, readings)

blocks.zh: USP 官方生效日期為 2024 年 8 月 1 日，你所在的實驗室 SOP 最後修訂於 2023 年。你需要審核 USP 〈791〉 的更新內容（如▲標記的修訂部分），確認哪些地方需要更新 SOP？
blocks.en: The official effective date of USP is August 1, 2024, and your laboratory SOP was last revised in 2023. You need to review the updates to USP <791> (such as the revised portions marked with ▲) and confirm which parts of the SOP need updating.

blocks.zh: 一個製劑的個論規定 pH 在 pH 6.0–7.5，量測值為 6.02。QC 分析員考慮再量測一次，因為「讀值太接近下限」。在 GMP 環境中，什麼情況下允許重測？重測需要如何記錄？
blocks.en: The monograph for a preparation specifies a pH of 6.0–7.5, and the measured value is 6.02. The QC analyst is considering measuring again because "the reading is too close to the lower limit". In a GMP environment, under what circumstances is a retest allowed? How should the retest be recorded?

blocks.zh: 如果一個樣品的 pH 規格是 pH <4.0，操作員提出用 pH 試紙代替電位計量測。依 USP 〈791〉 的精神，你會如何評估這個提議？
blocks.en: If the pH specification of a sample is pH <4.0, and the operator proposes using pH test paper instead of a potentiometer, how would you evaluate this proposal in the spirit of USP <791>?

blocks.zh: USP 〈791〉 完整章節要求摘要
blocks.en: Summary of the Complete Chapter Requirements of USP <791>

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 樣品量測三步驟：準備（用純化水配製，CO₂ 敏感樣品用煮沸水）→ 潤洗電極（用樣品潤洗 2–3 次）→ 浸入量測（記錄 pH 和溫度）
blocks.en: Three steps of sample measurement: preparation (prepare with purified water; use boiled water for CO₂-sensitive samples) → rinse the electrode (rinse 2–3 times with the sample) → immerse and measure (record pH and temperature)

blocks.zh: 所有量測必須使用 Nernst 溫度補償（手動或自動），並等待充分穩定
blocks.en: All measurements must use Nernst temperature compensation (manual or automatic), and sufficient time must be allowed for stabilization

blocks.zh: pH 指示劑和試紙只適用於「approximate pH values」場合，正式 QC 量測必須用電位計
blocks.en: pH indicators and test papers are suitable only where "approximate pH values" suffice; formal QC measurements must use a potentiometer

blocks.zh: pH >12 緩衝液（如 Ca(OH)₂）需立即使用或新鮮煮沸水配製，並防 CO₂ 入侵
blocks.en: Buffers with pH >12 (such as Ca(OH)₂) must be used immediately or prepared with freshly boiled water, and protected against CO₂ ingress

blocks.zh: USP 〈791〉 現行版本官方生效日期為 2024 年 8 月 1 日（含 2024 更新），由 General Chapters Chemical Analysis Expert Committee 維護
blocks.en: The official effective date of the current version of USP <791> is August 1, 2024 (including the 2024 update), and it is maintained by the General Chapters Chemical Analysis Expert Committee

blocks.zh: 重點提示 pH 量測在製藥品質體系中的位置
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Place of pH Measurement in the Pharmaceutical Quality System

blocks.zh: pH 雖然是最基本的物理化學測試之一，但在製藥 CDMO 中涉及多個層面：
blocks.en: Although pH is one of the most basic physicochemical tests, at a pharmaceutical CDMO it touches several areas:

blocks.zh: 製劑穩定性（Stability）：pH 是多數蛋白質藥品和小分子製劑最關鍵的穩定性指標之一；pH 偏移常是降解反應（水解、氧化）的前兆
blocks.en: Formulation stability: pH is one of the most critical stability indicators for most protein drugs and small-molecule formulations; a pH shift is often a precursor of degradation reactions (hydrolysis, oxidation)

blocks.zh: 製程控制（Process Control）：緩衝液配製、pH 調節、發酵監控均依賴 pH 量測的準確性
blocks.en: Process control: Buffer preparation, pH adjustment and fermentation monitoring all depend on the accuracy of pH measurement

blocks.zh: 患者安全（Patient Safety）：注射劑的 pH 直接影響注射疼痛、血管刺激性，偏離生理 pH（7.4）可能造成組織損傷
blocks.en: Patient safety: The pH of an injection directly affects injection pain and vascular irritation, and deviation from physiological pH (7.4) may cause tissue damage

blocks.zh: 法規符合（Regulatory Compliance）：USP 〈791〉 是 FDA 認可的強制性標準，不符合即為 OOS，可能導致批次拒絕
blocks.en: Regulatory compliance: USP <791> is a mandatory standard recognized by the FDA; non-compliance is an OOS and may lead to batch rejection
